summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of TickFlow application (Iteration 3). Fixed critical syntax error in TicketDrawer.js that prevented frontend from loading. Tested all Phase 2 user stories including registration, ticket CRUD, drawer functionality, export/import, analytics, and logout. CRITICAL ISSUE: Delete confirmation buttons still not appearing after clicking delete button - the main fix from this iteration is not working.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete confirmation buttons (Confirm/Cancel) do not appear after clicking the delete button. The onClick handler with preventDefault and stopPropagation is not triggering the state change to show confirmation buttons.
ui_bugs.details: After clicking the delete button (line 216-220 in TicketDrawer.js), the setShowDeleteConfirm(true) is not being triggered or the component is not re-rendering. The conditional rendering logic (lines 213-253) appears correct, but the state change is not happening. This is the MAIN fix that was supposed to be verified in this iteration.

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix delete confirmation flow in TicketDrawer component. The delete button is clickable, but clicking it does not show the confirm/cancel buttons. The onClick handler (lines 216-220) with e.preventDefault() and e.stopPropagation() followed by setShowDeleteConfirm(true) is not working. Possible issues: (1) Event handler not firing, (2) State update not triggering re-render, (3) Event propagation still being blocked by parent elements. Need to debug why setShowDeleteConfirm(true) is not causing the component to re-render with the confirmation buttons. Also fixed: Syntax error on line 43 (literal \n instead of newline) that prevented frontend from compiling.

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (18/19 critical features working, 1 critical issue with delete confirmation)
